current_task_binding.dataset_name: NLDAS-2: North American Land Data Assimilation System Forcing Fields

spatial_coverage.coverage: North American land domain from 24.85°N–53.28°N and 125.15°W–66.85°W; use the western-US subset and apply a forest mask for analysis.

analytical_capabilities: Derive daily and monthly temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind and radiation summaries
Compute fuel-aridity proxies such as vapor-pressure deficit, reference evapotranspiration and fire-weather indices from meteorological inputs
Aggregate seasonal and annual climate indicators over western-US forest grids
Calculate spatial anomalies, trends and drought-index covariates for fire-risk analysis

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NLDAS-2 meteorological forcing fields: temperature (°C), specific_humidity (mass fraction), pressure (Pa), wind_u/wind_v (m/s), radiation (W/m²), potential_evaporation and total_precipitation (kg/m²), plus convective_fraction (fraction) and potential_energy (J/kg).
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use catalog band names directly. Combine wind_u and wind_v to derive wind speed; aggregate hourly precipitation and radiation explicitly before computing daily fire indices. The collection is hourly at nominal 1/8° spacing, so it is not a precomputed FWI/ERC/KBDI/PDSI product. Apply the western-US and forest masks and retain the relevant 1979–2015 study interval.

current_task_binding.data_source: NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC), NLDAS-2

observation_identity_contract.core_measurement_semantics: hourly NLDAS-2 surface meteorological forcing variables
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: archive, variable subset, reprojection, resampling or temporal aggregation derived from NLDAS-2 forcing
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: ERA5, gridMET, PRISM, another reanalysis/forcing lineage or a precomputed index without NLDAS-2 input

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: NLDAS-2 FORA0125 hourly forcing fields are admitted; ERA5/ERA5-Land, gridMET, PRISM-only products and precomputed fire indices are distinct products.

directions.research_question: 多源气象 forcing 是否能够帮助深度学习模型减轻不同气象数据产品之间的不确定性并提高流量模拟性能？
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: LSTM 可以在时间和空间上动态组合 Daymet、Maurer 和 NLDAS forcing，从而利用其互补信息并缓解单一 forcing 的误差。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 模型使用 Daymet、Maurer 和 NLDAS 的日降水、日最高和最低气温、蒸汽压及地表辐射作为输入，并结合 27 个流域属性；NLDAS 输入是 CAMELS 中由 NLDAS 提供的流域平均日尺度 forcing，研究通过单源、双源和三源组合训练 LSTM，并以观测流量评估模拟结果。
directions.method_paradigm: 多源深度学习归因分析
directions.evidence_granularity: audited open full text Methods/Data section

source_paper.title: A note on leveraging synergy in multiple meteorological data sets with deep learning for rainfall–runoff modeling

quality.basis: Recomputed counts only; historical coverage/assessment labels are not copied.
